description.text: The hall is black but for the fanlight over the door, which lays a pale shape across the slates. The house ticks as it cools. One pair of boots by the scraper, which is yours, and a row of empty pegs above it.

A long hall running the front of the house, flagged in slate and colder than any room off it. Pegs for coats, a boot scraper worn to a curve by generations of feet, and a visitors' book open on a stand beside the door — open because nobody has had cause to close it, at a page four years old.

Step outside to the hill path
